articles.title: Fat Bear Week Is Back — and This Year It's Bigger Than Ever!
articles.summary: Sixteen brown bears in Alaska are competing to be crowned the fattest. They get ready for winter by eating tons of salmon. Voting starts September 22, and last year's champ, Chunk, weighs over 1,200 pounds!

articles.title: Big AI Companies Sued for Agreeing to Slow Down
articles.summary: A new lawsuit says four big AI companies made an illegal deal to slow down their AI development. People who pay for AI subscriptions say this makes the products less valuable. The companies haven't responded yet.

articles.title: White House Bans Some News Reporters
articles.summary: President Trump banned reporters from CNN, Politico, and MS NOW from the White House. Their press badges were taken away. The news outlets say this is against the law and they will fight it.
